patches.title: Keep the downstream documentation and repository-rule model
patches.reason: The personal fork uses a compact root constitution, repository-owned documentation tiers, and owner-controlled bilingual reconciliation.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: Repository instructions, documentation generators, and commit hooks execute before any DSH plugin is loaded.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: These files define repository policy and validation rather than an upstream runtime API.
patches.dataFormatEffect: Documentation pairing metadata remains repository-owned and versioned with its source documents.
patches.securityEffect: No runtime authority is added; commit-time checks remain local repository policy.
patches.migrationPlan: Restore upstream documentation gates only after they cover the fork's owner-controlled pairing workflow.
patches.rollbackPlan: Revert the isolated governance commits and regenerate documentation artifacts from the supported upstream base.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream adopts equivalent tiered instructions and an asynchronous owner-controlled bilingual workflow.

patches.title: Keep personal-fork Actions read-only and Windows-first
patches.reason: The public personal fork must not inherit official-repository write automation or Linux deployment assumptions; Windows 10 is the supported local runtime.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: GitHub Actions permissions and runner selection are evaluated outside the DSH plugin runtime.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: The difference is repository trust policy, not an API-version translation.
patches.securityEffect: Owner guards and read-only permissions remove inherited write authority; Linux remains advisory.
upstreamCanaryTests: pnpm exec vitest run scripts/ci-workflow.spec.ts scripts/fork-windows-workflow.spec.ts
patches.migrationPlan: Retain fork-owned workflow entry points while selectively importing upstream job improvements.
patches.rollbackPlan: Disable the fork workflows before restoring any official workflow file; never restore write permissions implicitly.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream workflows expose a repository-identity-safe downstream mode and equivalent Windows routing.

patches.title: Separate personal source packages from official publication identity
patches.reason: Personal product packages require an explicit @changanhua source identity while official packages retain @deepseek-ai ownership.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: Package names, TypeScript paths, workspace locks, release closure, and repository metadata are build-time identities.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: An adapter cannot change npm ownership or prevent an official release from traversing personal source packages.
patches.factOwnershipEffect: Package provenance is owned by downstream/package-identities.json; runtime domain facts are unchanged.
patches.dataFormatEffect: Package and lockfile identities change only for the explicit personal package set; persisted user data is unchanged.
patches.securityEffect: Publication remains fail-closed and personal packages remain private.
patches.migrationPlan: Use the registry-driven rescope script for newly classified personal packages; do not bulk-rewrite unlisted upstream packages.
patches.rollbackPlan: Reverse only registry-listed package identities and regenerate paths, catalogs, and the lockfile from the same commit.
patches.replacementCondition: Personal packages move to a separate workspace or upstream gains a first-class downstream namespace mechanism.

patches.title: Compose personal products through existing DSH bundles
patches.reason: Personal Queue, Delivery, runtime-fact, and workbench plugins must be mounted through supported Profile and Bundle composition without modifying their domain owners.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: The capabilities are plugins, but shipped personal product composition still requires bounded edits to upstream-owned bundle manifests and patches.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: The current upstream bundle has no external overlay declaration that can ship as part of this monorepo without touching its manifests.
patches.factOwnershipEffect: Bundles only compose providers and consumers; Queue, Delivery, Session, and Git keep their existing facts.
patches.securityEffect: Personal capabilities remain opt-in and inherit the owning service authority checks.
upstreamCanaryTests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/bundle/base packages/bundle/headless packages/bundle/web-app
patches.migrationPlan: Move personal rows into a standalone downstream Profile layer when profile distribution can reference external bundles without editing upstream manifests.
patches.rollbackPlan: Remove the personal rows and package edges from each bundle while preserving the underlying personal packages and data.
patches.replacementCondition: A shipped downstream overlay can compose all personal plugins without modifying upstream bundle files.

patches.title: Retain client slots used by personal workspaces
patches.reason: Personal Queue, capability, architecture, Delivery, and observatory views need stable client slots without replacing the conversation state owner.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: The personal views are plugins, but the supported upstream client shell at this base does not expose every required navigation and center-view slot.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: A thin adapter cannot register a slot the upstream shell does not expose.
patches.factOwnershipEffect: Client packages project Host facts and own no Queue, Delivery, or Session truth.
patches.dataFormatEffect: Only client-local view selection is retained; durable domain formats are unchanged.
patches.securityEffect: Browser projections remain read-only unless the owning Remote operation authorizes a mutation.
patches.migrationPlan: Adapt personal UI plugins to upstream-owned equivalent slots, then remove only the shell patch after dual behavior checks.
patches.rollbackPlan: Disable personal UI plugins and restore upstream shell components; Host domain data remains intact.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream client slots support the same lifecycle, navigation, and conversation-preservation behavior.

patches.title: Project personal runtime facts through stable Host and Client adapters
patches.reason: Personal runtime-fact and capability packages need narrow projections into upstream Host, client catalog, and preset composition points.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: Most behavior is plugin-owned; these remaining paths translate upstream registration and generated-catalog shapes at the integration boundary.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: not-applicable: this entry is the bounded compatibility adapter.
patches.securityEffect: Adapters expose only read-only projections and do not widen tool execution authority.
upstreamCanaryTests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/context packages/host packages/extensions
patches.migrationPlan: Provide the same personal service contract from an upstream-native registry when its behavior is equivalent.
patches.rollbackPlan: Remove adapter registrations; the owning personal stores and packages remain independently removable.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream exposes equivalent scoped registration and read-only projection contracts.

patches.title: Run Codex Delivery work without a live parent Agent
patches.reason: Operator-owned Delivery attempts require the existing Codex App Server adapter with explicit cwd and cancellation but no fabricated parent Agent session.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: The reusable Codex transport implementation is upstream-owned and originally bound execution to a parent Agent lifecycle.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: not-applicable: the runner change is retained as a narrow adapter and contains no Delivery state.
patches.securityEffect: The caller must provide the worktree cwd and AbortSignal; the adapter does not grant Queue or Delivery authority.
patches.migrationPlan: Switch the Delivery runner to an upstream-native parent-free execution operation after API and cancellation parity are proven.
patches.rollbackPlan: Disable the Personal Delivery runner and restore upstream Codex adapter behavior; existing Delivery records remain readable.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream Codex provider supports explicit cwd, parent-free invocation, AbortSignal, and process-tree quiescence.

patches.title: Preserve Windows process and recovery behavior used by personal workflows
patches.reason: Personal Windows workflows depend on deterministic cancellation, process-tree quiescence, checkpoint recovery, and bounded filesystem behavior.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: The affected lifecycle rules sit inside existing subprocess, checkpoint, terminal, and Skill owners.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: Wrapping these owners cannot repair cancellation or recovery invariants after the inner operation already commits an incorrect state.
patches.factOwnershipEffect: Existing Session, subprocess, and Skill services keep their facts; no new store is introduced.
patches.dataFormatEffect: Legacy Queue folds default missing dismissed state; no new incompatible persisted format is introduced here.
patches.securityEffect: Path checks and process teardown tighten existing boundaries.
upstreamCanaryTests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/session/session-checkpoint-policy packages/subprocess packages/skill
patches.migrationPlan: Cherry-pick or adopt upstream fixes only after Windows behavior parity is proven.
patches.rollbackPlan: Revert each isolated reliability commit independently; do not roll back persisted user data with code.
patches.replacementCondition: Equivalent fixes land upstream and pass the same Windows behavior tests.

patches.title: Keep tool registration and Agent inbox authority invariants
patches.reason: Personal Queue and multi-Agent consumers require object-rooted tool schemas, staged activation, and inbox ownership semantics that fail closed.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: Registration validation and inbox commit ordering must execute inside the service that owns those operations.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: An outer adapter can be bypassed by direct service consumers and cannot repair already-published state.
patches.factOwnershipEffect: Core Agent and Tool services retain their existing facts and enforce their own commit points.
patches.securityEffect: Invalid tool schemas and unauthorized staged work are rejected before publication.
upstreamCanaryTests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/agent packages/core/tools packages/experimental/agent-team
patches.migrationPlan: Drop individual fork commits when upstream behavior and negative tests become equivalent.
patches.rollbackPlan: Revert one invariant commit at a time and keep its negative test as the comparison oracle.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream enforces equivalent registration, activation, and inbox ownership at the final operation.

patches.title: Align web providers with personal settings and runtime facts
patches.reason: Web providers must consume the selected settings, credentials, and runtime-fact contracts without creating provider-specific policy stores.
patches.whyPluginIsInsufficient: The providers are plugins; these remaining edits adapt upstream package contracts to the personal settings plane.
patches.whyCompatibilityAdapterIsInsufficient: not-applicable: this entry is the bounded compatibility adapter.
patches.securityEffect: Credential resolution remains in the credential owner and provider configuration does not grant Agent authority.
upstreamCanaryTests: pnpm exec vitest run packages/web/web packages/web/web-search-exa packages/web/web-search-perplexity
patches.migrationPlan: Replace adapters with upstream provider settings contracts after behavior parity is proven.
patches.rollbackPlan: Remove the provider adapters and fall back to upstream provider configuration without migrating credential data.
patches.replacementCondition: Upstream providers consume equivalent settings, credential, and runtime-fact contracts.
